name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal-forced~p2
task: Taking the key means you must open the door too.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a conditional rule ('taking the key means you must open the door too'), and has_door_key is the condition, not a commanded goal, so RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) hard with no Existence clause is correct. Since the agent starts holding the key, the rule effectively requires opening the door eventually, and the rule-only warning plus empty FINAL_STATES is valid.

texts: if has_door_key happens, door_open must also happen
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, door_open) -> u2
(u1, door_open) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, door_open, u2) -> 1
